ValidationRule.description: CC-1882/CC-3672: Referrer Name and Referrer Email is required for Lead Source = Internal Referral ( also if Internal Referrer is blank for Commercial Bank)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead', OR( AND( OR( TEXT(Associated_Source_Detail__c) = 'Commercial Bank', TEXT(Associated_Source_Detail__c) = 'ANZ Plus Coach' ), TEXT(LeadSource) = 'Internal Referral', ISBLANK(FinServ__ReferredByUser__c), ISBLANK(Referrer_Email__c) ), AND( TEXT(Associated_Source_Detail__c) != 'Commercial Bank', TEXT(Associated_Source_Detail__c) != 'ANZ Plus Coach', TEXT(LeadSource) = 'Internal Referral', ISBLANK(Referrer_Email__c) ), AND( TEXT(Associated_Source_Detail__c) = 'Client Referral', TEXT(LeadSource) = 'External Referral', ISBLANK(FinServ__ReferredByContact__c), ISBLANK(Referrer_Email__c) ), AND( TEXT(Associated_Source_Detail__c) != 'Client Referral', TEXT(LeadSource) = 'External Referral', ISBLANK(Referrer_Email__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Referrer Email' is mandatory for Internal/External Referral lead
